nodes.label: Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)
nodes.rationale: Evidence-based; complete only after effectiveness is evaluated; must address root causes, not just lower assessment difficulty.

nodes.label: Material Change (Perubahan Signifikan)
nodes.rationale: Changes to LO, SLT, assessment, credit, MQF level, parent-course link or QV status require re-review and re-approval.

nodes.label: Micro-Credential Eksekutif (MCE)
nodes.rationale: Internal non-credit short learning (<40h SLT) for upskilling/reskilling; must be reclassified as SAMC to seek credit.

nodes.label: Micro-Credential (MC)
nodes.rationale: Recognises specific knowledge/skills via small focused units; completion alone never confers credit.

nodes.label: Programme Admission
nodes.rationale: Assessed separately from credit transfer; holding MC/ACR/ABC credit gives no automatic admission.

nodes.label: Quality Assurance (QA)
nodes.rationale: QA covers the whole MC ecosystem whereas QV is SAMC-specific.

nodes.label: Quality Verification (QV)
nodes.rationale: Distinct from internal UTeM approval: approval allows offering, QV verifies SAMC quality; QV never auto-grants credit transfer.

nodes.label: Stand-alone Micro-Credential (SAMC)
nodes.rationale: Standalone offering, not a formal component of an accredited programme; credit only via QV.

nodes.label: Stackable Degree
nodes.rationale: Planned pathway using approved credits toward a qualification; never an automatic award.

nodes.label: Suspension or Termination of Offering
nodes.rationale: Existing participants' interests must be protected via transition mechanisms; termination does not void valid achievements.

nodes.label: Unbundled Micro-Credential (UMC)
nodes.rationale: Unbundled from an accredited credit-bearing UTeM course; must keep a traceable link to its parent course.
